name: Actionbar Coords
summary: Keep your block position and the time of day in view at all times, shown in a small line just above your hotbar.
logoPrompt: A golden compass with a glowing clock face in its centre, resting on a grass block, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Where you are and what time it is.

description: **Actionbar Coords puts your coordinates and the time of day right above the hotbar, so you never need the debug screen to know where you are.**
- Shows the block you stand in as X, Y and Z, the same numbers the debug screen gives.
- Shows the time of day as a 24-hour clock, for example 14:05, so you know when night is coming.
- Updates four times a second while you move.
- On for every player from the start; `/trigger coords` hides it for you alone and brings it back.
Put the zip into the `datapacks` folder of your world (or pick it when you create a new world). The line appears at once. Type `/trigger coords` to switch it off or on.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. Players need nothing installed.
- The clock always follows the Overworld, also in the Nether and the End.
- Other messages above the hotbar, such as the name of a playing music disc, are replaced by the line within a moment.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
